description: Retrieve metadata and the file manifest for an Internet Archive item by identifier. Returns title, creator, description, subjects, collections, license, language, the total file count, and a page of files, each with its format, size, and direct download URL. Pages hold up to max_files files (default 50) starting at file_offset; set format to keep a single file type (e.g. "DjVuTXT", "Text PDF", "VBR MP3"). The primary tool to act on a search result from ia_search_items. Use ia_get_text to retrieve the readable text of a text item.

file_offset.description: Zero-based position in the (format-filtered) file list to start from (default 0). To read the next page, add max_files to the previous file_offset.

format.description: Keep only files whose format equals this value, ignoring case — e.g. "DjVuTXT", "Text PDF", "VBR MP3". Applied before paging. Omit to list every format.

identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier, e.g. "prideprejudice00aust" (Pride and Prejudice). Obtain from ia_search_items results.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to return (1–500, default 50).

name: ia_get_item

cap.description: The max_files cap that was applied.

collection.description: Collection(s) this item belongs to when provided.

creator.description: Creator or author name(s) when provided.

date.description: Publication or upload date when provided.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `item_not_found`: The identifier does not exist in the Internet Archive. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

file_count.description: Total number of files in the full item manifest, before filtering and paging.

files.description: This page of the manifest in upstream order — up to max_files files from file_offset, after the format filter.

items.description: A single file in the item manifest.

download_url.description: Direct download URL for this file.

language.description: Language(s) of the item when provided.

notice.description: Paging guidance with the next file_offset, or the formats present when the filter matched nothing.

shown.description: Number of files returned on this page.

subject.description: Subject or topic tag(s) when provided.

title.description: Item title when provided by the metadata.

totalCount.description: Number of files matching the format filter, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more files remain past this page.

title: Get Internet Archive Item
